How to hang things on the wall where you want them every time. It really does save a lot of time.

Put a dab of toothpaste right on the hangers on the back of frames, hold a level on top and place in the desired location on the wall. When you remove it you will have perfect marks to help you locate where to put your picture hanging hardware.
So simple, yet so perfect. As someone who just moved and must hang a ton of stuff thank you for this.
